content: The LAN-equals-safe assumption is explicitly warned against (Invicti misconceptions, selfhosted community Zero Trust advice): internal apps are prime lateral-movement targets, so TLS plus authentication are recommended even inside the LAN. Common afterthought failures: missing auth checks on some routes, missing session expiry/binding validation, missing cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), no rate limiting on login, confusing authentication with authorization. OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet is the canonical reference.
